summary.content:
Today's selection covers 50 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 35 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Turning the Tables on Email Scammers With 'ScamBuster'
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 22 articles published in the last 24 hours
